extracted.name: Creamed Turkey Gravy over biscuits
extracted.description: Great recipe for Creamed Turkey Gravy over biscuits.
ingredient_lines: 7 cups turkey (cooked, deboned and diced up to your preference. Can be chunked or shredded)
Season to taste (pinch of garlic powder,etc.)
instruction_lines: In a large skillet, start warming up the milk, heavy cream, butter and chicken stock.
Whisk in the flour and work out all the lumps.
Add salt, pepper and a bit of garlic powder.
Continue heating till it comes to a boil and thickens up.
Stir in the turkey and simmer together a bit. Taste test to see if needing any additional spices. Add milk if too thick.
